tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The room. Screen ground behind everything; also the colour of the app icon.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Grouped list rows, text fields, the iPad sidebar fallback. One step above bg.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, open-claim rows, solid sheet fallback when Reduce Transparency is on.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Meter tracks on dark, pressed rows, disabled fills. Never under control borders (line is only 2.9:1 here).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative separators between rows on dark. Not a control border.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Control borders on bg and surface-1 (3.5:1+). Text fields, unselected chips with an outline.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface-1..3 and on glass. Selected tab label.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary strong text; unselected tab labels and icons on glass (6.5:1 even over paper).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Meta and helper text on bg and surface-1..3. Never on glass.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Quietest text: footers, chevrons, timestamps on bg and surface-1..3 (5:1+). Never on glass.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Field placeholders on surface-1 (4.9:1).

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: The one action colour: the primary Button fill, the Scan button, switch on-track, links, focus on dark. One lime thing per screen.

tokens.name: lime-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a lime fill.

tokens.name: lime-tint
tokens.usage: Lime wash behind selected rows in pickers; lime text stays readable on it (9.9:1).

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text and icons on lime and glass-lime.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and Switch Control focus on dark grounds and glass: 2pt solid ring, 2pt offset.

tokens.name: focus-ring-paper
tokens.usage: Focus ring on paper and paper-2 (lime is 1.2:1 there).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Time is close, on dark: the deadline dot, DUE labels on dark, due meter fills on dark. Never decoration, never errors.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Due text on glass and on signal-tint.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a due row or banner on dark, under signal-soft text.

tokens.name: settled
tokens.usage: Done on dark: SETTLED, COVERED labels and settled meters on dark grounds.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions only (Delete item, Delete account) on bg and surface-1..3 (5.7:1+). Always with a verb.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Bills and receipts: the paper card ground.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Policies, vehicle papers, agreements and the claim ledger: the document card ground.

tokens.name: paper-rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines on paper (between data rows, ledger entries). Decorative only.

tokens.name: paper-track
tokens.usage: Meter track on paper and paper-2.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Figures and titles on paper; the strongest ink.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body text and data on paper and paper-2.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels and meta on paper and paper-2 (5.2:1+).

tokens.name: due-ink
tokens.usage: Time is close, on paper: the day count when 7 days or fewer, DUE labels, due meter fill (5.3:1 on paper-2).

tokens.name: covered-ink
tokens.usage: COVERED and SETTLED labels on paper and paper-2 (5.0:1+).

tokens.name: ended-ink
tokens.usage: ENDED labels and lapsed dates on paper and paper-2 (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: read-highlight
tokens.usage: Behind a value read from the user's photo on the review screen; ink-2 text on it.

tokens.name: miss-tint
tokens.usage: Behind a field the reader couldn't read on paper; miss-ink text on it.

tokens.name: miss-ink
tokens.usage: Couldn't-read hint text on miss-tint.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Fallback Liquid Glass fill (80%) under the blur, for every glass surface when native glass isn't available. Keeps text and text-2 at 6.5:1+ even over paper.

tokens.name: glass-lime
tokens.usage: Tinted glass for the Scan button only; on-lime icon on it.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: Top specular edge of fallback glass (1pt inset highlight).

tokens.name: glass-rim-shade
tokens.usage: Hairline ring around fallback glass.

tokens.name: glass-selection
tokens.usage: The moving selection capsule inside the tab bar and segmented controls on glass.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a large-detent sheet and the camera's edges.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Screen titles: Home, Vault, Settings. Scales with Large Title. Collapses to nav-title on scroll.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Item name on detail, sheet titles at large detent. Scales with Title 1.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Sheet titles at medium detent, empty-state headlines. Scales with Title 2.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Item names on cards. Scales with Title 3.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The day count on item detail. Tabular figures. One per screen.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Day counts on DeadlineCard. Tabular figures.

styles.name: figure-sm
styles.usage: Amounts and claim day numbers inside cards. Tabular figures.

styles.name: nav-title
styles.usage: Inline title once the large title collapses; Inter, not Bricolage.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Keep the bill and its warranty date together.
styles.usage: Reading text and list row titles. Scales with Body.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body; row titles that lead a group. Scales with Headline.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Supporting lines on cards and sheets. Scales with Callout.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: DeadlineAccessory and Toast text, small buttons. Scales with Subheadline.

styles.name: footnote
styles.sample: PaperDrawer gives guidance, not legal advice.
styles.usage: Footers and helper text under fields. Scales with Footnote.

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: Tab bar labels only. Sentence case, never mono.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE eyebrows, section headers and card meta. Write the text in caps; the style does not transform.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Dates, reference numbers, serials and amounts in data rows on paper.

styles.name: data-strong
styles.usage: The one value a data row is about (the total, the REF).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, status label vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between glass controls; label-to-value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a list; row inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; grouped-row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: iPhone screen margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above a large title; iPad screen margin.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Bottom clearance under the last row (plus the measured tab bar inset).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Thumbnails of the original photo inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inner elements inside a 14pt card (photo, highlight).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Paper cards, grouped lists, text fields. Draw as a continuous (squircle) corner on iOS.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass panels and the DeadlineAccessory; iPad sidebar.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheet top corners, concentric with the iPhone screen.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tab bar, chips, StatusLabel, switches, glass buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Under every floating glass control.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Above a sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-paper-pressed
tokens.usage: Paper card while pressed or dragged. Paper has no shadow at rest.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and text fields.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons inside cards and toasts.

tokens.name: glass-button
tokens.usage: Round glass toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: tab-bar-height
tokens.usage: The glass tab bar and the Scan button beside it.

tokens.name: tab-bar-min
tokens.usage: Tab bar and Scan button when minimised on scroll.

tokens.name: accessory-height
tokens.usage: DeadlineAccessory and Toast.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Longest reading column (iPad detail, Mac window).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: iPad and Mac sidebar.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur of fallback glass.

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: Backdrop saturation of fallback glass, so paper colours glow through.

tokens.name: pressed-scale
tokens.usage: Scale of a card or glass control while pressed.
